paite: Huchi in ka dak nawn a, ngai in, tang nih kikal a kipan in kangtalai li a hong paikhia ua, huai tangte dal tang ahi uhi.
heading: Kangtalai Leh Sakolte Muhna

paite: Kangtalai khat in sakol san anei ua kangtalai nihna in sakol vom;
kangtalai thumna in sakol ngou; kangtalai lina in sakol puang hat anei uhi.
Huan kei hon houpih angel ka dong a akiang ah, "Hiaite bang ahi ua, ka toupa?" ka chi hi.
Angel in ahon dawng a, ka kiang ah, "Hiaite van huih lite, leitung pumpi Toupa ma a va dingh khin a paikhete ahi uh.
Sakol vomte omna kangtalai mallam gam ah apaikhia ua; amau zui in angoute tumlam ah apawtkhia ua; apuangte simlam zuan in apawtkhia uhi."
Huan sakolte apaikhia ua, lei kantan a avialvak theihna ding uh angaklah uhi. Ama'n, "Hiai a kipan pai unla, lei kantan in vialvak un,” achi a, huchi in lei kantan in avialvak uhi.
Huchi in ahon sam a, ka kiang ah thu agen a, "Ngai in, mallam gam zuan a paite'n mallam gam ah ka kha akhawlsakta uh," achi hi.
Huan ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung hi:
heading: Siampu Lian Joshua Lallukhu Khuksakna

paite: Babulon a kipan saltang hong pai Heldai, Tobijah leh Jedaiah a pan thilpiak la in; ani mah in pai inla, Zephaniah tapa Josiah inn ah lut in.
Ahi, amau a kipan dangka leh dangka-eng la inla, kumpi lukhute bawl in, Jehozadak tapa Joshua, siampu lianpen luzang ah khusak in.
Huan akiang ah thu gen inla, huchibang in sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi: Ngai in, mi amin Kahiang: amun a kipan ahong kakhe ding a, ama'n TOUPA tempul alam ding hi.

Ama'n TOUPA tempul alam ding a, thupina silhsak in a-om ding a, alaltutphah tung ah atu dia, vai ahawm ding; alaltutphah tung ah siampu ahi ding; huchi in amau gel kikal ah lemna thuhilhna a-om ding hi.
Kumpi lukhute Helem, Tobijah, Jedaiah leh Zephaniah tapa Hen kiang ah, TOUPA tempul atheihgigena ding in a-om ding uhi.

Huan gamlapi a omte ahong pai ding ua TOUPA tempul ahong lampih ding ua, huchi in sepaihte' TOUPA'N na kiang a kei hon sawl ahi chih na thei ding hi. Huchi in hiai ahong tung ding, TOUPA na Pathian aw pilvangtak a na man uleh, achi, chi in.
